1	import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest'
2	import { RateLimiter } from '../src/rate-limiter'
3	
4	describe('RateLimiter', () => {
5	  beforeEach(() => {
6	    vi.useFakeTimers()
7	    vi.setSystemTime(new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'))
8	  })
9	
10	  afterEach(() => {
11	    vi.useRealTimers()
12	  })
13	
14	  it('allows the first request', () => {
15	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
16	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
17	  })
18	
19	  it('blocks the request after max in fixed mode', () => {
20	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
21	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) limiter.allow('user-1')
22	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
23	  })
24	
25	  it('honors a configurable max value', () => {
26	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 2, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
27	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
28	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
29	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
30	  })
31	
32	  it('tracks each key independently', () => {
33	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 2, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
34	    limiter.allow('user-1')
35	    limiter.allow('user-1')
36	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
37	    expect(limiter.allow('user-2')).toBe(true)
38	  })
39	
40	  it('resets the count when the fixed window ends', () => {
41	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 2, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'fixed' })
42	    limiter.allow('user-1')
43	    limiter.allow('user-1')
44	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
45	    vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000)
46	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
47	  })
48	
49	  it('blocks subsequent calls in sliding mode within the trailing window', () => {
50	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding' })
51	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) limiter.allow('user-1')
52	    vi.advanceTimersByTime(500)
53	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
54	  })
55	
56	  it('blocks in sliding mode across a fixed-window boundary when calls have not aged out', () => {
57	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding' })
58	    vi.advanceTimersByTime(500)
59	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) limiter.allow('user-1')
60	    vi.advanceTimersByTime(500)
61	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(false)
62	  })
63	
64	  it('allows again in sliding mode once the oldest call ages out', () => {
65	    const limiter = new RateLimiter({ max: 5, windowMs: 1000, mode: 'sliding' })
66	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) limiter.allow('user-1')
67	    vi.advanceTimersByTime(1100)
68	    expect(limiter.allow('user-1')).toBe(true)
69	  })
70	})
